vectors.name: mutual-remove
vectors.note: A and B remove each other at the same time: both are removed, C stays

vectors.name: removed-adds-later
vectors.note: X is removed, then signs add Y on top of the removal: Y is never a member

vectors.name: backdated-add
vectors.note: X is removed and signs add Y with parents from before the removal. A member that has not seen the removal accepts Y until it gets the removal

vectors.name: backdated-remove
vectors.note: X is removed and signs remove W with parents from before its removal: W is removed too, X gains nothing

vectors.name: stolen-removes-remover
vectors.note: a stolen device X removes the device A that removed it: both are removed, the others stay (removal wins)

vectors.name: remove-all-others
vectors.note: a stolen device removes all others before anyone removes it: all others are removed

vectors.name: remove-all-and-removed
vectors.note: X removes all others while B removes X at the same moment: X is removed too

vectors.name: remove-while-adding
vectors.note: A removes B while B adds C at the same time: C is not a member

vectors.name: double-remove
vectors.note: A and B both remove X at the same time: X is removed, both removals are effective

vectors.name: leave
vectors.note: a device removes itself (leaves the group)

vectors.name: double-add
vectors.note: a second add of a key that is already a member changes nothing

vectors.name: re-add-removed
vectors.note: a removed key that is added again stays removed

vectors.name: removal-ring
vectors.note: A removes B, B removes C, C removes A, all at once: all three are removed, W stays

vectors.name: backdated-child
vectors.note: Y was added by a back-dated add of removed X. Y's rename is invalid; Y's remove of W is effective (5.6 row 3)

vectors.name: rotate-tie-break
vectors.note: two members rotate to epoch 1 at once: the one with the higher change ID is the current secret change

vectors.name: rotate-by-removed
vectors.note: a removed device signs a back-dated rotate: it is not valid, the secret stays at the genesis

changes.label: rot2
changes.why: rotate epoch is not 1 plus the highest epoch in its past

vectors.name: not-well-formed
vectors.note: changes that are refused and never stored: bad signature, parents not sorted, second genesis, signer never added, rotate with a wrong epoch
